title: Notification centre and personal settings
problem: The bell showed five made-up rows that all opened the orders list, and nobody could choose what to get.
now: The bell shows real items from the shop; View all opens a page with filters, read and unread, and each person's settings.
steps: Open the bell in the top bar
Tap a row to open its page
Open Settings and switch Sound on for New orders
notes: Where: Top bar bell › View all notifications (/notifications), Settings tab (/notifications?tab=settings) · Needs the server: Email and SMS are kept as a choice only; sending them needs the server.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
